title: Review: feat(secretx): secretx URI support for all secrets
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — one correctness bug (smtp warn-not-exit), one latent drift risk (duplicate CredentialStore), one UX gap (opaque TlsError). No security surface expanded beyond the new secretx path. The duplicate resolve_secret_uri is low-risk today but will compound.
Confidence: 10% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: no integration test that exercises secretx path end-to-end (startup with a real or mocked secretx backend); smtp credential behavior untested for the warn-vs-exit case. Would raise confidence if: a test spins up smtp with a secretx: credential_file pointing at a failing backend and asserts the daemon exits non-zero.
